original_sql: SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaypositioningclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 85 AND 100 AND t2.buildupplaydribbling > 50

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'amide' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Polyamide%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'CHEM%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 19 AND 22 AND m.label LIKE 'Ti%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 26 AND 31 AND m.label LIKE 'Cu%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'Z%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Zandvoort%')
SELECT C.asciiname, C.watermark FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Commander' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 5.0
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 70 AND s.position < 7 AND d.nationality = 'Portuguese'
SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Blonde%' ORDER BY sh.id DESC
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM laptimes GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 500;

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 200 AND 300 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'Q%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS v WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Marin') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING < (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Cleanup' WHERE u.reputation >= 9000 AND u.creationdate > '2016-01-01'
SELECT C.name, C.manaCost FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.id IS NULL

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.enroll12) AS avg_enrollment FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.enroll12) DESC nulls last LIMIT 4) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, avg_enrollment DESC;
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'argon' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'NOBLE%'
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 4

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 75 AND 85 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.marking > 70 AND p.height > 175 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 5;
SELECT s.resultid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM results AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 54 AND s.points > 190 AND d.nationality = 'South African'
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN artist LIKE 'A%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN convertedmanacost = 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN hasfoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
SELECT raceid, fastestlaptime FROM (SELECT raceid, fastestlaptime, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rank FROM results GROUP BY raceid, fastestlaptime) subq WHERE rank = 1
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id LIKE 'X%' ORDER BY atom_id DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt BETWEEN 7 AND 11 AND m.label LIKE 'O%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 628 THEN 628 WHEN s.id = 629 THEN 629 WHEN s.id = 630 THEN 630 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id IN (628, 629, 630) AND c.colour = 'Black'

WITH molecule_bond_elements AS (SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM bond UNION ALL SELECT molecule_id AS mol FROM molecule) SELECT mol AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM molecule_bond_elements GROUP BY mol HAVING COUNT(*) < (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM molecule_bond_elements GROUP BY mol) AS avg_elements);
SELECT atom_id as current_atom, LEAD(atom_id) OVER (ORDER BY bond_seq) as next_atom, bond_type as bond_kind FROM bond_ref b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_type = c.bond_id

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_expenditure FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1200 ORDER BY total_expenditure ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS eye_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero GROUP BY publisher_id, eye_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.eye_colour_id = C.id ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, AVG(demographics.weight) AS avg_weight FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = TRUE AND demographics.gender = 'Male' AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he > 4 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

WITH connections AS (SELECT atom_id AS atom FROM connected UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS atom FROM connected) SELECT atom AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM connections GROUP BY atom HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM connections GROUP BY atom) AS avg_connections);

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'K%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Mar%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 300000 AND weight > 75 AND height < 185 AND weight < 80);
SELECT * FROM member WHERE zip >= 15000 AND zip <= 35000 AND link_to_major = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY t_shirt_size NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cu' AND br.bond_seq > 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST
SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.defencepressureclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.defencepressure BETWEEN 70 AND 90
SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.element, a2.element) IN (('F', 'Br'), ('F', 'I'), ('Br', 'I'))
SELECT s.constructorstandingsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 23 AND s.points > 30
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 26 AND (MAX(red_cards) - MIN(red_cards)) > 7;
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'P%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 6 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(hours) > 30
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm ASC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 7

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS covalent_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'covalent' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY covalent_bonds DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Mg' AND br.bond_seq < 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS hydrogen_bond_count FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'W%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY hydrogen_bond_count ASC
SELECT s.qualifyid, s.raceid, d.driverid FROM qualifying AS s INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE s.raceid = 72 AND s.position < 9 AND d.nationality = 'Malaysian'
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'p' THEN 1 END) AS p_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('si', 'b') THEN molecule_id END) AS si_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

WITH member_attendance_analysis AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_attendance AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2.5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_attendance_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_attendance WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Workshops FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Workshop' AND e.status = 'Approved' AND b.spent > 250 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1200

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_3 FROM (SELECT atom_id, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM atom_view) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id
SELECT raceid, COUNT(*) FROM pitstops GROUP BY raceid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Orange' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY artist, asciiname, name, setcode, rarity, convertedmanacost, power, toughness, colors, keywords, subtypes, types, layout, frameversion, bordercolor, watermark, multiverseid, originaltype, originaltext, originalreleasedate, flavortext, frameeffects, hand, life, loyalty) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'single' AND atom.element = 'Nitrogen'

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.strength FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.strength > 90

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'nd' THEN 1 END) AS nd_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('pm', 'sm') THEN molecule_id END) AS lanthanide_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 42 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'N' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 90 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 90 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 500 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_attendance_hours FROM attendance WHERE hours > 2 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(hours) > 10

SELECT s.School FROM schools s WHERE s.County IN ('Alameda', 'Contra Costa')
GROUP BY s.School HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.County) = 2;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name, COUNT(q.driverid) AS qualifying_drivers, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year > 2017 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name HAVING COUNT(q.driverid) > 12
SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget FROM budget WHERE amount > 500 GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(amount) > 2000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND br.bond_seq > 4 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, br.bond_seq NULLS FIRST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Acid%' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'MOL%'

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, R.race AS race, sqPR.publisher_race_count AS count_by_publisher_race FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, race_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_race_count FROM superhero WHERE race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, race_id) sqPR ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPR.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN race R ON sqPR.race_id = R.id WHERE R.race LIKE 'Mutant%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, R.race;
SELECT cards.artist, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM card_type WHERE card_type.cardid = cards.id AND card_type.type = 'Legendary') THEN 'legendary' ELSE 'not legendary' END FROM cards
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 65 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 225

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS hair_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.hair_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Ash Blonde%' AND sh.weight_kg BETWEEN 50 AND 65 ORDER BY sh.id ASC

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name, COUNT(r.raceid) AS race_count, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE r.year > 2010 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name HAVING COUNT(r.raceid) > 5
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Bi%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Vox Populi' WHERE u.reputation >= 2500 AND u.creationdate > '2019-01-01'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Rb' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 5 AND 9 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'standard' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'XXL' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Pioneer' WHERE u.reputation >= 25000 AND u.creationdate < '2015-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Tumbleweed' WHERE u.reputation >= 1000 AND u.creationdate < '2011-01-01'

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 101 AND 110 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'O' AND b.bond_type = 'single' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceteamwidth, ta.defenceteamwidthclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2017-12-15 00:00:00'
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 15

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.long_shots FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.long_shots > 80

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.interceptions > 82 AND p.height > 182 AND pa.marking > 78 AND pa.standing_tackle > 80 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 8;
SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 3 AND s.height_cm > 190
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Historic' AND C.convertedmanacost = 20.0

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq = 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 5' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Merced' AND sa.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM atom AS a1 INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON (a1.element, a2.element) IN (('Au', 'Ag'), ('Au', 'Pt'), ('Ag', 'Pt'))

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.amount, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 400 AND 800 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT C.name, C.artist FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost BETWEEN 2.0 AND 4.0 AND C.rarity = 'Mythic' AND C.hasfoil = 1

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.antireflux_treatment_types, COUNT(lifestyle_and_risk_factors.antireflux_treatment_types) AS treatment_type_count FROM patients JOIN lifestyle_and_risk_factors ON patients.patient_id = lifestyle_and_risk_factors.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND lifestyle_and_risk_factors.antireflux_treatment_types IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, lifestyle_and_risk_factors.antireflux_treatment_types ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent BETWEEN 200 AND 500 ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond_list.bond_id, bond_list.bond_type, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list ON connected.bond_id = bond_list.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Rn' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond_list.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM driverstandings GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'W' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '2' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '1' AND toughness = '0') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(e.ana, 0) AS ana_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN examination AS e ON p.id = e.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE c.district_id BETWEEN 10 AND 15 AND d.type = 'DISPONENT' LIMIT 350;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'phosphodiester' AND molecule.label LIKE 'RNA%'
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expenditure FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 40 AND 120 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 180

SELECT raceid, points AS modal_points FROM (SELECT raceid, points, COUNT(*) AS freq, MIN(resultid) AS first_occurrence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(resultid) ASC) AS rn FROM results GROUP BY raceid, points) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY raceid;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN transact_dt_tm END) AS transact_dt_tm_2 FROM (SELECT bond_type, transact_dt_tm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rn FROM bond_list) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Benito', 'Del Norte') GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT s.county, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.district = 'San Jose Unified' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN atom_id END) AS atom_id_2 FROM (SELECT molecule_id, atom_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY atom_id DESC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igg > 27 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgG, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN iga > 27 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgA, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN igm > 27 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_IgM FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.phone, e.location, b.category, z.county FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 300 AND 800 ORDER BY b.amount ASC NULLS FIRST

WITH connections AS (SELECT atom_id AS atom FROM connected UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS atom FROM connected) SELECT atom AS id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM connections GROUP BY atom HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM connections GROUP BY atom) AS min_connections);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'inactive' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.state

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'He' AND bl.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, bl.bond_type DESC
SELECT * FROM member_privileges WHERE privilege_level >= 'Member' AND privilege_level <= 'Officer' AND member_id = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY created_at NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Fe' AND b.bond_type = 'metallic' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT s.district, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'Mendocino' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.interceptions > 85 AND p.height > 185 AND pa.marking > 80 AND pa.standing_tackle > 85 AND pa.sliding_tackle > 80 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 15;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_ref.bond_seq FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_ref ON atom.element = 'Ar' AND bond_ref.bond_type = 'dipolar' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id DESC

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP1 DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP2 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP2 AS SUBGROUP_BEFORE_5 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 5

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 85 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 85 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 425 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Very_High_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

WITH TEAMATTRS AS (SELECT BUILDUPPLAYSPEED AS VALUE, 'Team_Attributes' AS IDENTIFIER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY BUILDUPPLAYSPEED NULLS FIRST) AS RN FROM team_attributes) SELECT PLAYERATTRS.VALUE, PLAYERATTRS.IDENTIFIER, TEAMATTRS.VALUE, TEAMATTRS.IDENTIFIER FROM (SELECT OVERALL_RATING AS VALUE, 'Player_Attributes' AS IDENTIFIER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY OVERALL_RATING NULLS FIRST) AS RN FROM player_attributes) AS PLAYERATTRS FULL OUTER JOIN teamattrs ON PLAYERATTRS.RN = TEAMATTRS.RN
SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.buildupplayspeed FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed > 70

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.sm FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.sm = 'Positive' GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.sm HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.sm = j.sm)
SELECT link_to_member, AVG(cost) AS avg_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 25 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING AVG(cost) < 75

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, cs.wins FROM constructors c INNER JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.points > 300 AND cs.wins > 15 ORDER BY cs.wins DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM member WHERE zip > 80000 GROUP BY link_to_major HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 35 ORDER BY r.fastestlapspeed DESC LIMIT 12;

SELECT m.t_shirt_size, e.location, b.category, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.amount BETWEEN 600 AND 1100 ORDER BY b.amount DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.location AS circuitlocation, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.laps AS totallaps FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2021 AND res.points > 18 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.position ASC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 130 AND 150 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pt' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'single' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT year_created, tagname, cnt_posts FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) AS year_created, t.tagname, COUNT(p.id) AS cnt_posts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posts_backup AS p INNER JOIN tags AS t ON p.tags LIKE '%' || t.tagname || '%' WHERE t.tagname LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creaiondate AS DATE)), t.id, t.tagname) AS p WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posts DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 151 AND 160 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 90 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 300
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'disulfide' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'INORG%'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS total_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'triple' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY total_bonds ASC
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'beryllium' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'METAL%'
SELECT t1.* FROM packages t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM packages GROUP BY description) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Diego' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrread ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT raceid, q1 FROM (SELECT raceid, q1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q1) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q1 IS NOT NULL AND q1 <> '0' AND q1 LIKE '4%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '1%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '2%' AND q1 NOT LIKE '3%'

SELECT s.cname AS county, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS reading_weighted_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.cname IN (SELECT s.cname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.cname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.5 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.cname, sch.school ORDER BY s.cname, reading_weighted_score DESC;

SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplaydribblingclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplaydribbling BETWEEN 80 AND 100 AND t2.chancecreationshooting > 75
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 100 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 500
SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attendance WHERE hours BETWEEN 5 AND 7) AND M.position = 'Event Supervisor'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'H' ORDER BY m.label DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST

SELECT s.constructorstandingsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 73 AND s.points > 300 AND c.nationality = 'Japanese'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq = 2 AND m.label LIKE 'C6H12O6%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq ASC
SELECT * FROM attribute JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE NOT (attribute_name = 'Stamina' AND attribute_value BETWEEN 35 AND 55)

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.aptt, 0) AS aptt_level FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' AND l.aptt BETWEEN 60 AND 70 ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT account_id FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(trans_id) > 12 AND (MAX(balance) - MIN(balance)) > 100000;

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 800 THEN 800 WHEN s.id = 801 THEN 801 WHEN s.id = 802 THEN 802 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (800, 801, 802) AND a.attribute_name LIKE 'Durability%'

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'pd' THEN 1 END) AS palladium_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('ag', 'au') THEN molecule_id END) AS precious_metal_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;
SELECT * FROM zip_code WHERE zip_code >= 30000 AND zip_code <= 40000 AND state = 'California' ORDER BY city NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'P' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, br.bond_seq DESC
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_single_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'single' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_single_bonds DESC

SELECT s.superhero_name, g.gender, p.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE s.alignment_id = 1 AND s.weight_kg BETWEEN 90 AND 110 AND s.height_cm > 190

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_list.bond_id) AS aromatic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'aromatic' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE ha.attribute_value < 30 AND s.alignment_id = 3
SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE zip BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 GROUP BY link_to_major HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT account_id FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(trans_id) > 5 AND (MAX(balance) - MIN(balance)) > 50000;

SELECT constructorid, positiontext FROM (SELECT constructorid, positiontext, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY constructorid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM constructorstandings GROUP BY constructorid, positiontext) subq WHERE rank = 1
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 7 AND (MAX(minutes_played) - MIN(minutes_played)) > 600;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'MOL012') AS molecule_id_count, element, COUNT(*) AS element_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (element)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Xe' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.dob AS driverbirthdate, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.grid AS startposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2018 AND res.points > 15 AND res.positionorder <= 7 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.grid DESC

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'Y%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS unique_iodine_atoms FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'I' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = 'SUCROSE') AS label_count, molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS molecule_id_count FROM molecule GROUP BY ROLLUP (molecule_id)

SELECT * FROM superhero JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id WHERE NOT (superhero_name = 'Flash' AND height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190)

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.jumping FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.jumping > 85

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.city FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'volunteer' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.city

SELECT link_to_member, SUM(hours) AS total_volunteer_hours FROM attendance JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE hours >= 5 AND member.position = 'Volunteer' GROUP BY link_to_member
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'ATOM006') AS atom_id_count, atom_id2, COUNT(*) AS atom_id2_count FROM connected GROUP BY ROLLUP (atom_id2)

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) JOIN (SELECT p.diagnosis, l.aptt FROM patient AS p JOIN laboratory AS l ON (p.id = l.id) WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSS' AND l.aptt > 75 GROUP BY p.diagnosis, l.aptt HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) AS j ON (p.diagnosis = j.diagnosis AND l.aptt = j.aptt)
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'amide' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'PHARM%'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.event_name, b.remaining FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.remaining BETWEEN 200 AND 800 ORDER BY b.remaining DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday, AVG(l.glu) AS avg_glucose_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.birthday

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 18 ORDER BY r.fastestlapspeed ASC LIMIT 7;

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Co%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' ORDER BY combined_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC

SELECT sqA.alignment_count AS total_by_alignment, A.alignment AS alignment, R.race AS race, sqAR.alignment_race_count AS count_by_alignment_race FROM (SELECT alignment_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_count FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id) sqA INNER JOIN (SELECT alignment_id, race_id, COUNT(*) AS alignment_race_count FROM superhero WHERE race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alignment_id, race_id) sqAR ON sqA.alignment_id = sqAR.alignment_id INNER JOIN alignment A ON sqA.alignment_id = A.id INNER JOIN race R ON sqAR.race_id = R.id WHERE A.alignment = 'Good' AND R.race LIKE 'Human%' ORDER BY A.alignment, R.race;

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_hydrogen_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_hydrogen_bonds DESC

WITH HERO_ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS (SELECT HERO_ID, ATTRIBUTE_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE_VALUE DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM HERO_ATTRIBUTE) SELECT H1.HERO_ID AS CURRENT_HERO, H2.HERO_ID AS HERO_AFTER_6 FROM HERO_ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS H1 LEFT JOIN HERO_ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS H2 ON H2.RANK = H1.RANK + 6

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 25 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime ASC LIMIT 8;

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes)

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP1 DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP2 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP2 AS SUBGROUP_BEFORE_7 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK - 7

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence, COUNT(pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence) AS metastasis_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence = FALSE AND demographics.gender = 'Female' GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_metastasis_radiographic_evidence ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Si' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'He' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 3 ORDER BY r.fastestlapspeed DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE av.cnt BETWEEN 2 AND 5 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_type FROM atom LEFT JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 LEFT JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'metallic'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element, molecule.label, bond_list.transact_dt_tm FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bond_list ON atom.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'Pd' AND bond_list.bond_type = 'quadruple' ORDER BY molecule.label DESC, atom.atom_id ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'K' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id DESC, bl.transact_dt_tm ASC
SELECT m.member_id FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.link_to_member IS NULL AND i.amount > 75 AND i.source = 'donation' AND m.position = 'Officer'

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.stamina FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.stamina > 88 AND Player_Attributes.strength > 85

SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.igm, 0) AS immunoglobulin_m_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

WITH ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS (SELECT ID, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM ATTRIBUTE) SELECT A1.ATTRIBUTE_NAME AS CURRENT_ATTRIBUTE, A2.ATTRIBUTE_NAME AS ATTRIBUTE_BEFORE_3 FROM ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS A1 LEFT JOIN ATTRIBUTE_RANK AS A2 ON A2.RANK = A1.RANK - 3

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'k%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST
SELECT player_id FROM player_stats GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(match_id) > 38 AND (MAX(assists) - MIN(assists)) > 18;

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'R' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '3008') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '3009') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '3010') WHEN (colors = 'W' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '3011') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ester' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Fragrance%'
SELECT C.name, C.rarity FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Historic' AND C.convertedmanacost = 0.0
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.sex, COALESCE(l.tg, 0) AS triglyceride_status FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id ORDER BY p.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.remaining, z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.remaining BETWEEN 400 AND 900 ORDER BY b.remaining ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000
SELECT district_id FROM district GROUP BY district_id HAVING COUNT(a8) > 2 AND (MAX(a10) - MIN(a10)) > 500;

SELECT t1.team_short_name, t2.buildupplayspeedclass FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplayspeed BETWEEN 50 AND 70 AND t2.defencepressure > 65
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING < (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING > (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONSHOOTING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT s.superhero_name, a.alignment, c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.gender_id = 1 AND s.weight_kg BETWEEN 70 AND 90 AND s.height_cm > 170
SELECT t1.team_long_name, t2.buildupplaydribbling FROM team t1 INNER JOIN team_attributes t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildupplaydribbling > 40

WITH HERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WEIGHT_KG DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT H1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_NOW, H2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_BEFORE_2 FROM HERO_RANK AS H1 LEFT JOIN HERO_RANK AS H2 ON H2.RANK = H1.RANK - 2
SELECT P.player_name, P.weight, PA.overall_rating FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.weight BETWEEN 70 AND 80 AND PA.overall_rating > 80
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'MOL003') AS molecule_id_count, element, COUNT(*) AS element_count FROM atom GROUP BY ROLLUP (element)

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.4 + s.avgscrread * 0.4 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, balanced_sat_score DESC;
SELECT C.artist, C.power FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Modern' AND C.convertedmanacost = 4.0

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.goals FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.goals > 3 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 85 AND 95 AND pr.potential_rating > 90 AND p.minutes_played > 70 LIMIT 210;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 12.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Moderate_Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 135 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Mild_Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 11.5 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT s.county, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numtsttakr FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.district = 'Long Beach Unified' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 5;

WITH GENDER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, GENDER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM GENDER) SELECT G1.GENDER AS CURRENT_GENDER, G2.GENDER AS GENDER_AFTER_3 FROM GENDER_RANK AS G1 LEFT JOIN GENDER_RANK AS G2 ON G2.RANK = G1.RANK + 3
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element ASC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 4
SELECT bond_type, bond_seq FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type LIKE 'M%' ORDER BY bond_seq DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.dob AS driverbirthdate, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.grid AS startposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2021 AND res.points > 18 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.grid ASC
SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'mercury' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'HEAVY%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count, zip_code.state FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.position = 'active' AND zip_code.type = 'military' GROUP BY zip_code.state, member.position

SELECT sh.id AS hero_id, sh.superhero_name, c.colour AS skin_color FROM superhero AS sh JOIN colour AS c ON sh.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE c.colour LIKE '%Bronze%' AND sh.weight_kg > 85 ORDER BY sh.id DESC

SELECT s.city, sa.avgscrread, sa.avgscrmath, sa.numge1500 FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.county = 'San Francisco' AND sa.rtype = 'D' ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath ASC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM expense WHERE cost >= 100.0 AND cost <= 500.0 AND link_to_budget = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY expense_description NULLS FIRST
SELECT player_api_id, player_name FROM player WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Kyl%' AND player_fifa_api_id > 480000 AND weight > 70);
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) FROM constructors GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) > 7;

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 100 THEN 100 WHEN s.id = 101 THEN 101 WHEN s.id = 102 THEN 102 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id IN (100, 101, 102) AND p.publisher_name LIKE 'Marvel%'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlapspeed FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 10 ORDER BY r.fastestlapspeed DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT C.artist, C.toughness FROM cards AS C LEFT JOIN legalities AS L ON L.uuid = C.uuid WHERE L.format = 'Legacy' AND C.convertedmanacost = 1.0

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.spent, z.state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.spent > 200 AND b.spent < 400 ORDER BY b.spent ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT constructorid, COUNT(*) FROM constructorstandings GROUP BY constructorid HAVING COUNT(*) > 4;

SELECT s.constructorstandingsid, s.raceid, c.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.raceid = 67 AND s.points > 270 AND c.nationality = 'Swiss'

SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.assists FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.assists > 2 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 82 AND 88 AND pr.potential_rating > 84 LIMIT 165;

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Research' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Research' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT year_created, websiteurl, cnt_posthistory FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.websiteurl, COUNT(ph.id) AS cnt_posthistory, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(ph.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM posthistory AS ph INNER JOIN users AS u ON ph.userid = u.id WHERE u.websiteurl LIKE 'https%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ph.creationdate AS DATE)), u.websiteurl) AS ph WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_posthistory DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.height, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, MIN(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS min_lymph_nodes_examined FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = FALSE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.height, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Deputy' WHERE u.reputation >= 7000 AND u.creationdate > '2018-01-01'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Na' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Luis Obispo', 'Santa Barbara') AND s.charter = 0 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'Y' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 2;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 11 AND 15 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.displayname, u.reputation, b.name AS badge_name, b.date AS badge_date FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = u.id AND b.name = 'Revival' WHERE u.reputation >= 2500 AND u.creationdate < '2013-01-01'

SELECT sqR.race_count AS total_by_race, R.race AS race, C.colour AS eye_colour, sqRC.race_colour_count AS count_by_race_colour FROM (SELECT race_id, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM superhero WHERE race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY race_id) sqR INNER JOIN (SELECT race_id, eye_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS race_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY race_id, eye_colour_id) sqRC ON sqR.race_id = sqRC.race_id INNER JOIN race R ON sqR.race_id = R.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqRC.eye_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Blue%' ORDER BY R.race, C.colour;
SELECT raceid, q3 FROM (SELECT raceid, q3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, q3) subq WHERE rank = 1 AND q3 IS NOT NULL

WITH member_events AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_member ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event), event_members AS (SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, SUM(hours) AS total_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY link_to_event ORDER BY SUM(hours) DESC) AS rank, 'Event Top Hours' AS result_type FROM attendance WHERE hours > 5 GROUP BY link_to_member, link_to_event) SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM member_events WHERE rank <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, link_to_event, total_hours, result_type FROM event_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, link_to_member, link_to_event

WITH SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUBGROUP2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBGROUP1 DESC NULLS LAST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP) SELECT S1.SUBGROUP2 AS CURRENT_SUBGROUP, S2.SUBGROUP2 AS SUBGROUP_AFTER_12 FROM SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_GROUP_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 12

SELECT year_created, websiteurl, cnt_comments FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.websiteurl, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt_comments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE u.websiteurl LIKE 'http%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.creationdate AS DATE)), u.websiteurl) AS c WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_comments DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 221 AND 230 GROUP BY RACEID

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, av.cnt FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN atom_view AS av ON a.atom_id = av.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'Ne' AND av.cnt BETWEEN 2 AND 6 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 22

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = 'polar covalent' THEN 1 END) AS polar_covalent_bonds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('nonpolar covalent', 'coordinate covalent') THEN molecule_id END) AS other_covalent_bonds FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 112 THEN 112 WHEN s.id = 113 THEN 113 WHEN s.id = 114 THEN 114 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.alignment FROM superhero AS s JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (112, 113, 114) AND a.alignment = 'Evil'
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING, TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.CHANCECREATIONPASSING < (SELECT AVG(CHANCECREATIONPASSING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEAGGRESSION > (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEAGGRESSION) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCETEAMWIDTH) FROM team_attributes)
SELECT cdscode, COUNT(opendate) FROM schools WHERE county = 'Fresno County' GROUP BY cdscode LIMIT 13

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 150 AND 170 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' AND b.bond_type = 'covalent' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrread) AS avg_reading_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrread) DESC nulls last LIMIT 6) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, avg_reading_score DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lat AS circuitlatitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2016 AND res.points > 14 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlapspeed DESC

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 5 AND 15 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.ethnicity, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.free_kick_accuracy FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.free_kick_accuracy > 88 AND Player_Attributes.curve > 85
SELECT p.player_id, p.match_id, p.red_cards FROM player_stats p JOIN player_rate pr ON p.player_id = pr.id WHERE p.red_cards > 0 AND pr.overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 70 LIMIT 85;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'z%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) AS balanced_sat_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.6 + s.avgscrread * 0.2 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.2) DESC nulls last LIMIT 9) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, balanced_sat_score DESC;

SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 're' THEN 1 END) AS re_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('os', 'ir') THEN molecule_id END) AS platinum_group_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'Q%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Quarry%')

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 3 AND 7 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.gender, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN hgb < 10.0 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Anemia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN plt < 100 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Thrombocytopenia, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN wbc > 15 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Leukocytosis FROM laboratory GROUP BY id
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 25
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element DESC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 4

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_votes FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(v.id) AS cnt_votes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(v.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(v.creationdate AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS v WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_votes DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE bl.transact_dt_tm < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT link_to_member, AVG(cost) AS avg_expense FROM expense WHERE cost BETWEEN 50 AND 150 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING AVG(cost) > 75

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE br.bond_seq BETWEEN 29 AND 34 AND m.label LIKE 'Mn%' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT s.school FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Francisco', 'Santa Clara') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 0 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS hair_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, hair_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, hair_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.hair_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Auburn%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, SUM(bond_ref.bond_seq) AS total_bond_seq FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond_ref ON bond_list.bond_type = bond_ref.bond_type GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 25 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime DESC LIMIT 15;

        THEN 'common'
        ELSE 'not common'
