SELECT p.id, p.sex FROM patient AS p JOIN examination AS e ON (p.id = e.id) JOIN (SELECT p.sex, e.ana FROM patient AS p JOIN examination AS e ON (p.id = e.id) WHERE p.sex = 'Female' AND e.ana > 1 GROUP BY p.sex, e.ana HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS j ON (p.sex = j.sex AND e.ana = j.ana)

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.name AS teamname, res.grid AS qualifyingposition, res.fastestlap FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 AND res.points > 5 AND res.positionorder <= 10 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.grid DESC
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bonds FROM bond_list GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Mg' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN got > 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_GOT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN gpt > 30 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_GPT, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ldh > 200 THEN 'TRUE' END), 'FALSE') AS Elevated_LDH FROM laboratory GROUP BY id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Zn' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, br.bond_seq DESC

SELECT '2022-09-01' AS reporting_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN opendate < '2022-09-01' AND (closeddate IS NULL OR closeddate >= '2022-09-01') THEN 1 END) AS active_magnet_schools FROM schools WHERE magnet = 1;
SELECT * FROM packages WHERE 3 = (CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN weight_kg < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN is_fragile = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

SELECT t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, ta.buildupplayspeed, ta.buildupplayspeedclass, ta.chancecreationpassing, ta.chancecreationpassingclass, ta.defenceaggression, ta.defenceaggressionclass FROM team t INNER JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = '2025-08-15 00:00:00'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_ref WHERE bond_type = 'SINGLE') AS bond_type_count, bond_seq, COUNT(*) AS bond_seq_count FROM bond_ref GROUP BY ROLLUP (bond_seq)

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS Total_Event_Budget FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.event_status = 'Approved' AND b.category = 'Workshop' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 3500

SELECT P.player_name, P.height, PA.defensive_work_rate FROM player AS P JOIN player_attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN 150 AND 160 AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'High'

SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM expense WHERE cost > 300 AND approved = 'Pending' AND link_to_budget = 'recBUD54321') AND M.position = 'Financial Compliance Analyst'

WITH SUPERHERO_RANK AS (SELECT ID, SUPERHERO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY HEIGHT_CM ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM SUPERHERO) SELECT S1.SUPERHERO_NAME AS CURRENT_HERO, S2.SUPERHERO_NAME AS HERO_AFTER_13 FROM SUPERHERO_RANK AS S1 LEFT JOIN SUPERHERO_RANK AS S2 ON S2.RANK = S1.RANK + 13
SELECT s.district FROM schools s WHERE s.county IN ('San Bernardino', 'Riverside') AND s.charter = 1 AND s.magnet = 1 AND s.virtual = 'N' GROUP BY s.district HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.county) = 3;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'l%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS FIRST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

WITH GENDER_RANK AS (SELECT ID, GENDER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ID ASC NULLS FIRST) AS RANK FROM GENDER) SELECT G1.GENDER AS CURRENT_GENDER, G2.GENDER AS GENDER_AFTER_4 FROM GENDER_RANK AS G1 LEFT JOIN GENDER_RANK AS G2 ON G2.RANK = G1.RANK + 4

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom_view WHERE atom_id = 'ATOM001') AS atom_id_count, cnt, COUNT(*) AS cnt_count FROM atom_view GROUP BY ROLLUP (cnt)

SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE cost > 30 GROUP BY link_to_member HAVING SUM(cost) > 100

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Ca' AND br.bond_seq > 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.bond_id DESC) AS rnk FROM bond a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 3
SELECT MAX(a10) FROM (SELECT a10, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a10 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 3)

SELECT av1.cnt, av2.cnt FROM atom_view AS av1 INNER JOIN atom_view AS av2 ON (av1.cnt, av2.cnt) IN ((7, 8), (7, 9), (8, 9))

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, br.bond_type, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON c.bond_id = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cu' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, br.bond_seq NULLS LAST

SELECT * FROM budget WHERE remaining >= 400.0 AND remaining <= 1200.0 AND link_to_event = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY spent DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT * FROM connected LEFT JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id WHERE atom.element = 'antimony' AND atom.molecule_id LIKE 'METALLOID%'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND m.label LIKE 'H2O%' AND a.element = 'H' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id ASC, b.bond_type DESC

SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.element DESC) AS rnk FROM atom a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 12

SELECT s.driverStandingsId, s.raceId, d.driverId FROM driverstandings AS s CROSS JOIN drivers AS d WHERE s.raceId = 26 AND s.points > 45
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_budget, link_to_event FROM budget WHERE event_status = 'active' AND amount > 1000 GROUP BY link_to_event

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.remaining) AS unspent_funds FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND e.type = 'Training' GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.remaining) > 2500 ORDER BY unspent_funds DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_elements FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.country AS circuitcountry, d.forename AS driverfirstname, d.surname AS driverlastname, co.nationality AS teamnationality, res.grid AS startposition, res.fastestlap FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2020 AND res.points > 25 ORDER BY r.raceid DESC, res.grid ASC

SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.player_name, Player_Attributes.free_kick_accuracy FROM player LEFT JOIN player_attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id AND Player_Attributes.free_kick_accuracy > 80

SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY name) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
SELECT molecule_id as current_molecule, LEAD(molecule_id) OVER (ORDER BY label) as next_molecule, label as molecule_category FROM molecule m

SELECT m.email, e.event_name, b.remaining, z.short_state FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member LEFT JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE b.remaining BETWEEN 300 AND 900 ORDER BY b.remaining ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS combined_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_type FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Cl%' OR b.bond_type IN ('peptide', 'disulfide') ORDER BY combined_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Er%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-02-15' AND '2023-08-15' ORDER BY composite_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_seq FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Li' AND br.bond_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS unified_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS chemical_reference, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property_description FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Re%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY unified_key ASC, chemical_reference DESC

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, bl.bond_id, bl.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'H' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, bl.bond_id NULLS LAST

WITH member_privileges_analysis AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY privilege_level ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Privilege Top 3' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Leadership' AND approval_status = 'Approved' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id), privilege_members AS (SELECT privilege_level, member_id, COUNT(1) AS total_privileges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC) AS rank, 'Member Top Privilege' AS result_type FROM member_privileges WHERE is_active = true AND privilege_scope = 'Leadership' AND approval_status = 'Approved' GROUP BY privilege_level, member_id) SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM member_privileges_analysis WHERE rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT privilege_level, member_id, total_privileges, result_type FROM privilege_members WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY result_type, privilege_level, member_id

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, b.bond_id, br.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id INNER JOIN bond_ref AS br ON b.bond_type = br.bond_type WHERE a.element = 'Cl' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS FIRST, c.atom_id2 NULLS LAST

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type, c.atom_id2 FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id LEFT JOIN bond_list AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Pt' AND b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' ORDER BY m.label ASC, a.atom_id DESC, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS FIRST

SELECT s.dname AS district, sch.school, AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.6 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) AS reading_weighted_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE s.dname IN (SELECT s.dname FROM satscores s GROUP BY s.dname ORDER BY AVG(s.avgscrmath * 0.3 + s.avgscrread * 0.6 + s.avgscrwrite * 0.1) DESC nulls last LIMIT 5) GROUP BY s.dname, sch.school ORDER BY s.dname, reading_weighted_score DESC;

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2 FROM (SELECT bond_type, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY molecule_id ASC) AS rn FROM bond) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT bond_type, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_3 FROM (SELECT bond_type, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY molecule_id DESC) AS rn FROM bond) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 7 GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY bond_type

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'B' AND power = '6' AND toughness = '5') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7074') WHEN (colors = 'G' AND power = '5' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7075') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND power = '4' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7076') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND power = '3' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '7077') END) AS watermark FROM cards

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, c.atom_id2, bl.bond_id, bl.transact_dt_tm FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond_list AS bl ON c.bond_id = bl.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'Au' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, c.atom_id2 NULLS FIRST
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'as' THEN 1 END) AS as_atoms, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element IN ('se', 'te') THEN molecule_id END) AS se_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT CASE WHEN s.id = 700 THEN 700 WHEN s.id = 701 THEN 701 WHEN s.id = 702 THEN 702 END AS fixed_id, s.superhero_name, a.attribute_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (700, 701, 702) AND a.attribute_name LIKE 'Dexterity%'

SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.country LIKE 'F%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM circuits WHERE circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId AND circuits.name LIKE '%Forest%')

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.fastestlaptime FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND r.position <= 5 AND r.points > 10 ORDER BY r.fastestlaptime ASC LIMIT 6;

SELECT RACEID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 1 THEN DRIVERID END) AS WINNER, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 2 THEN DRIVERID END) AS RUNNER_UP, MAX(CASE WHEN POSITIONORDER = 3 THEN DRIVERID END) AS THIRD_PLACE FROM results WHERE POSITIONORDER <= 3 AND LAPS BETWEEN 161 AND 170 AND POINTS > 15 GROUP BY RACEID
SELECT t1.* FROM cards t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM cards GROUP BY convertedmanacost) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS racename, c.lng AS circuitlongitude, d.code AS drivercode, co.nationality AS constructornationality, res.position AS finishposition, res.fastestlaptime FROM races AS r INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors AS co ON res.constructorid = co.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2018 AND res.points > 14 AND res.positionorder <= 4 ORDER BY r.raceid ASC, res.fastestlaptime DESC

SELECT TA.ID, TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING, TA.CHANCECREATIONCROSSING, TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE, TA.DEFENCETEAMWIDTH FROM team_attributes AS TA WHERE TA.BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING > (SELECT AVG(BUILDUPPLAYDRIBBLING) FROM team_attributes) AND TA.DEFENCEPRESSURE < (SELECT AVG(DEFENCEPRESSURE) FROM team_attributes)

SELECT p.player_name, p.height, COUNT(pa.id) AS defensive_count FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.interceptions > 85 AND p.height > 185 GROUP BY p.player_name, p.height HAVING COUNT(pa.id) > 9;

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond_list.bond_id) AS recent_ionic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond_list ON molecule.molecule_id = bond_list.molecule_id WHERE bond_list.bond_type = 'ionic' AND bond_list.transact_dt_tm > '2024-01-01' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY recent_ionic_bonds DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS expense_count, link_to_budget FROM expense WHERE cost > 100 AND approved = 'true' GROUP BY link_to_budget

SELECT COALESCE(a.atom_id, b.bond_id) AS composite_key, COALESCE(a.molecule_id, b.molecule_id) AS molecule_ref, COALESCE(a.element, b.bond_type) AS property FROM atom AS a FULL OUTER JOIN bond_list AS b ON a.atom_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element LIKE 'Te%' OR b.transact_dt_tm BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY composite_key DESC, molecule_ref ASC
SELECT MIN(a14) FROM (SELECT a14, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a14 DESC NULLS LAST) AS Rank FROM district) AS E WHERE (Rank = 4)

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'silicon' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_bonds DESC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, atom.atom_id, atom.element, bond.bond_id, bond.bond_type FROM molecule INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2 INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'Mg' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id DESC, atom.atom_id DESC, bond.bond_id ASC

SELECT year_created, displayname, cnt_badges FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) AS year_created, u.displayname, COUNT(b.id) AS cnt_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)) ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM badges AS b INNER JOIN users AS u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname LIKE 'L%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.date AS DATE)), u.id, u.displayname) AS b WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY year_created NULLS FIRST, cnt_badges DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT atom_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN molecule_id END) AS molecule_id_2 FROM (SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY atom_id ORDER BY molecule_id ASC) AS rn FROM atom) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY atom_id ORDER BY atom_id
SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) FROM results GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) > 200;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ether' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Anesthetic%'
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'double' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Polymer%'

SELECT d.name, d.department, COUNT(a.appointment_id) AS appointment_count FROM doctors d JOIN appointments a ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id WHERE a.appointment_date > '2023-01-01' AND d.age > 35 GROUP BY d.name, d.department HAVING COUNT(a.appointment_id) > 5;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond_list AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type LIKE 'n%' ORDER BY m.label NULLS LAST, b.transact_dt_tm NULLS LAST
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, AVG(l.fg) AS avg_fibrinogen_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.fg > 200 GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.admission, MAX(l.gpt) AS max_gpt_level FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON p.id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sex, p.admission
SELECT t1.* FROM legalities t1 JOIN (SELECT min(id) as id FROM legalities GROUP BY format, status) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

SELECT molecule.label, COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS silicon_ionic_bonds FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'ionic' AND bond.molecule_id LIKE 'Si%' GROUP BY molecule.label ORDER BY silicon_ionic_bonds DESC

SELECT M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name FROM member AS M WHERE M.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM expense WHERE cost > 200 AND approved = 'No' AND link_to_budget = 'recBUD67890') AND M.position = 'Procurement Manager'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.atom_id, a.element, b.bond_id, b.bond_type FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'C' AND b.bond_type = 'triple' ORDER BY m.molecule_id DESC, a.atom_id NULLS LAST, b.bond_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT sqP.publisher_count AS total_by_publisher, P.publisher_name AS publisher, C.colour AS skin_colour, sqPC.publisher_colour_count AS count_by_publisher_colour FROM (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_count FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id) sqP INNER JOIN (SELECT publisher_id, skin_colour_id, COUNT(*) AS publisher_colour_count FROM superhero WHERE skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publisher_id, skin_colour_id) sqPC ON sqP.publisher_id = sqPC.publisher_id INNER JOIN publisher P ON sqP.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN colour C ON sqPC.skin_colour_id = C.id WHERE C.colour LIKE 'Yellow%' ORDER BY P.publisher_name, C.colour;
SELECT * FROM budget WHERE amount >= 3000 AND amount <= 7000 AND link_to_event = 'recggMW2eyCYceNcy' ORDER BY category DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count, COUNT(primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count) AS lymph_node_examined_count FROM patients JOIN pathology_and_surgery ON patients.patient_id = pathology_and_surgery.patient_id JOIN demographics ON patients.patient_id = demographics.patient_id WHERE informed_consent_verified = TRUE AND pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count BETWEEN 70 AND 80 GROUP BY patients.patient_id, demographics.race_list, pathology_and_surgery.primary_pathology_lymph_node_examined_count ORDER BY patients.patient_id;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(b.spent) AS Total_Spent_On_Fundraising FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id = b.link_to_event JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Fundraising' AND e.status = 'Planned' AND b.spent > 100 GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 800

SELECT id, (CASE WHEN (colors = 'W' AND toughness = '4') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '2000') WHEN (colors = 'U' AND toughness = '3') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '2001') WHEN (colors = 'B' AND toughness = '2') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '2002') WHEN (colors = 'R' AND toughness = '1') THEN COALESCE(watermark, '2003') END) AS watermark FROM cards
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.transact_dt_tm DESC) AS rnk FROM bond_list a) subquery WHERE rnk <= 1
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label, bond.bond_type FROM molecule LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = 'hydrogen' AND molecule.label LIKE 'Water%'
